behavior.name: Test Detection Only
behavior.author: Gabriel Novas
behavior.description:
Detection and calibration ONLY, from the pictures and robot poses already stored for a camera, robot and cell (parameter "cell"): it computes the calibration again without the robot.
Requires, in ~/calibrations/CAMERA/extrinsic_calibration/ROBOT/CELL/: - pictures/ and robot_poses/ and the intrinsic calibration of the camera.
FLOW: 1. Process_Offline: detects Charuco in the stored pictures (charuco_table_poses/) 2. Compute_Calibration: VISP calculates the camera-robot transformation (calibration_results/camera_extrinsics.yaml)

param.name: camera_type
param.label: Camera Type
param.hint: Select camera model (realsense_d435i or other) to resolve calibration folder

param.name: robot_name
param.label: Robot Name
param.hint: Select robot model (ur5e or ufactory_lite6): it sets the frames and the calibration folder

param.name: cell
param.label: Cell
param.hint: Cell whose stored pictures and poses are processed (for example right, left, basic, kth_table)

param.name: calibration_file_name
param.label: Calibration File
param.hint: Output file name (saved in the calibration_results folder of the camera, robot and cell)
